Recorded on 16 Jun 2025. Listen to Prof. Krzysztof Pawłowski on Polskie Radio 3's Piknik Naukowy programme, giving a brief overview of the state of the art in quantum technologies and how EUCENTRAL is going to contribute to the field.  

Jun 24, 2025

Recorded on 18 Jul 2025. Listen to Prof. Remigiusz Augusiak on Polskie Radio 1's Eureka programme, describing the EUCENTRAL project, its team, its goals, and CTP's place on the map of quantum technologies.

Coming in 2026: an opportunity to establish and lead a new Quantum Modelling Group. Are you ready to shape the future of quantum research? Stay tuned - details of the upcoming competition will be announced soon.

Jun 11, 2025

On 26-27 June, CTP PAS had the pleasure to host Dr. Abbie Bray (UCL). Dr. Bray conducted two training sessions, teaching our senior staff (researchers as well as administrative and management staff) more about the best practices in recruitment and retainment in academia, as well as about open science, outreach, and public engagement.
